question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā operate up to māyā?
premises: The operation reaches up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, with the siddhas, acts up to the limit of māyā by supreme will
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is ambiguous
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
